long_biography.plain_text:
Born in 1955 and educated in economics and law, Khalilov built his early career in the oil sector. He represented Lukoil in Turkey and later held senior roles at Lukoil Overseas and Slavneft, gaining experience across energy, trade and regional business development. In the mid-1990s he founded ISR Holding, extending that platform beyond oil into transport, property, hotels and consumer businesses.

ISR became associated with large oil-product rail fleets, hotel developments in Baku and Turkey, branded automotive distribution, retail and iodine production. Khalilov combined founder ownership with investment partnerships rather than concentrating on one operating company. His sons Rahman and Rauf later assumed leading roles in logistics and group management, while he retained a founder and investor identity across the family's businesses.
